summary: 2. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: (a) “Grant a Transmission Licence under Sections 14 and 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003 in favour of the Applicant, TUMKUR-II RE TRANSMISSION LIMITED, to build, own, operate and transfer of the “Transmission system strengthening at Tumkur-II for integration of additional RE potential (2.7 GW)”, being the Inter-State transmission system; and (b) Direct issuance of the Transmission Licence in the prescribed Form-III of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for grant of Transmission Licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2024, subject to the general and specific conditions contained therein; and/or (c) Condone any minor, inadvertent or procedural defects or omissions, if any, in the present Petition and permit the Applicant to place on record such additional documents, information or clarifications as this Hon’ble Commission may require from time to time in the interest of justice; and (d) Pass such other order / orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.” Hearing dated 4.8.2026 3. Notice was issued to the parties to file their replies and rejoinders. During the course of the hearing, the representative of the Petitioner mainly reiterated the submissions made in the Petition. He further submitted that CTUIL had furnished its recommendations in support of the grant of the transmission licence. He also submitted that the name of the Petitioner company had been changed and sought liberty to file an affidavit along with the relevant supporting documents to place the said change on record. 4. Vide the Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as the ‘RoP’) dated 4.8.2026, the Petitioner was directed to implead GR Infra as a party to the Petition and file an amended memo of parties. Thereafter, necessary amendments, if any, were also directed to be carried out in the Petition in terms of Regulation 37(2) of the Conduct of Business Regulations. The Petitioner was further directed to file an affidavit, placing on record the change in the name of the Petitioner company. Order in Petition No. 329/TL/2026 Page 7 5. In compliance with the RoP dated 4.8.2026, the Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 12.8.2026, placed on record the amended memo of parties. The Petitioner also placed on record, vide affidavit dated 12.8.2026, the change in the name of the Petitioner company from “Tumkur-II RE Transmission Limited” to “POWERGRID Tumkur Madhugiri Transmission Limited”, along with the Certificate of Incorporation dated 27.7.2026. Hearing dated 3.9.2026 6. During the hearing, the representative of the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner has complied with the directions issued vide RoP dated 4.8.2026. He further submitted that, pursuant to the said RoP, the Respondents were granted an opportunity to file their replies; however, none of the Respondents has filed any reply. Accordingly, after hearing the representative for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for order. 7. The Petitioner has submitted that in accordance with the “Guidelines for Encouraging Competition in Development of Transmission Projects” and “Tariff Based Competitive Bidding Guidelines for Transmission Service” (hereinafter referred to as “the Guidelines”) issued by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, under Section 63 of the Act, PFC Consulting Limited (hereinafter referred to as “PFCCL”) was notified by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, vide Gazette Notification. No. CG-DL-E-21082025-265554 dated 19.8.2025 as the Bid Process Coordinator (hereinafter referred to as “BPC”) for the purpose of selection of bidder as the Transmission Service Provider (hereinafter referred to as “TSP”) to establish the inter-state “Transmission System Strengthening at Tumkur-II for Integration of Additional RE Potential (2.7 GW)”. 8. PFCCL, in its capacity as the BPC, initiated the bid process on 19.11.2025 Order in Petition No. 329/TL/2026 Page 8 with the various regulations of the Central Electricity Authority regarding Technical Standards and Grid Standards, Prudent Utility Practices and other applicable laws. Further, Article 5.4 of the TSA provides that the TSP shall ensure that the Project is designed, built and completed in a good workman-like manner using sound engineering and construction practices and using only materials and equipment that are new and of international utility-grade quality such that the useful life of the Project will be till the expiry date. Further, the design, construction, and testing of all equipment, facilities, components, and systems of the Project shall be in accordance with Indian Standards and Codes issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards. In this regard, the Petitioner has submitted that it will implement the Project in accordance with the provisions of the TSA. It is expected that while carrying out the survey, the Petitioner has complied with the provisions of clause 2.5.7.3, clause 2.5.7.4, and clause 2.5.7.5 of the RfP. The Petitioner will comply with the provisions of the bidding documents and the TSA for the commissioning of the Project within the SCOD. 27. The Petition shall be listed for final hearing on 5.11.2026. Sd/- sd/- sd/- (Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) title: Petition under Sections 14 & 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for Grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 with respect to Transmission Licence to Tumkur-II RE Transmission Limited (now known as POWERGRID Tumkur Madhugiri Transmission Limited).
